quotes.partner_name: This GP Co-Investment Agreement is entered into as of March 31, 2022 between Example Sponsor LLC (the "Sponsor") and Placeholder Capital Partners LP (the "Partner"). (p.1)
quotes.scope: This Agreement governs the Sponsor's co-investment in Sample Industrial Venture I and every investment it makes. (§1.1)
quotes.capital_pct: The Partner shall fund fifty percent (50%) of the Sponsor's capital commitment to Sample Industrial Venture I, and the Sponsor shall fund the balance. (§2.1)
quotes.promote_pct_of_gp_side: The Partner shall be entitled to twenty-five percent (25%) of the promote distributed to the Sponsor by Sample Industrial Venture I. (§3.1)
quotes.fees: The Partner shall not be entitled to any fee. All asset management, property management, construction management and other fees are payable to the Sponsor. (§4.1)
quotes.effective_date: This Agreement is effective as of March 31, 2022. (§5.1)
